label: Full Filter Bar
description: Everything in one filter bar. Best for nine fields on one bar with picks pinned atop every option list, an exclusive Unassigned row and the query printed as JSON.

label: Nested Attributes
description: Nested attributes at workspace scale. Best for a 2,000 attribute branch generated across eight record types, with search synonyms such as zip for postcode and type icons on nested leaves.

label: Status Badges
description: Status and priority colour badges. Best for picks shown as tinted badges until a third one folds them into a swatch stack with a count, plus a chip that takes no value.

label: Avatars & Paging
description: Avatars, paging and a restored view. Best for a stored query of bare ids restored by a button, with contact names fetched for ids no search has loaded yet, and a Reset to the seed.

label: Date Editors
description: A date and a date range editor. Best for typed phrases like next friday or a calendar click for one day, and a two month calendar with last 7 and 30 day presets for a range.

label: Slider Editor
description: Sliders as the value editor. Best for health score and monthly spend bounds dragged on a thumb, with the closed chip drawing a mini rail of the span and its maximum.

label: Table Filtering
description: Filtering a table. Best for a chip bar in a Card over a 12 person staff grid that sorts, pages, returns to page 1 on every edit and shows an empty message.

label: Choice Controls
description: Choice controls as editors. Best for kit form controls as editors that commit per press, staying open for multi picks and closing after a single plan or region pick.

label: Typed Inputs
description: Typed values in kit inputs. Best for dollar amounts with a per month unit, pasted keywords one per line, a 6 character code that commits when full and a domain check.

label: Popover Builder
description: Nested groups in a popover. Best for a deal pipeline card whose header trigger opens a reorderable builder seeded with an OR group, with short operator words such as at least.

label: Inline Builder
description: Nested groups inline, walked back out. Best for fields mapped to storage columns such as story_points, with a button that loads a group nested two deep and a live rule count.

label: Controlled & Translated
description: Controlled, sized and translated. Best for english, German and Japanese copy over one query, a small or default size switch, read only and disabled states and a log of change reasons.
